replay.detail: Run-tree rebuild-reason profiling adds no startup replay trigger or projection invalidation.

schema.detail: No SQLite migration, table, index or trigger change in run-tree rebuild-reason profiling; schema version remains 16.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules remain 11; no changed digest policy or new sealing coordination requirement.

compatibility.detail: With profiling enabled, up to eight run-tree dirty-reason counters are added. Counts represent marking invocations, not distinct trees or rebuild durations; correlate them within the same revision and process window. Projection decisions, APIs, claims and stored data remain unchanged.

downtime.detail: No additional service interruption or measured upgrade outage is introduced by run-tree rebuild-reason profiling; normal daemon/client restart procedures apply.

manual.detail: Existing installations need no configuration conversion or manual data repair for run-tree rebuild-reason profiling.

recovery.detail: No additional recovery procedure is introduced. Preserve graph state, keys and configuration and follow roll-forward guidance; this fragment does not qualify binary-only rollback of the whole release.
